items.title: VCs, Superhuman Mail founder share red flags about product market fit
items.summary: Top investors from Iconiq and Sapphire Ventures, along with Rahul Vohra, the founder of Superhuman Mail share the do's and don'ts for building hit products.
items.creator: Dominic-Madori Davis

items.title: TechCrunch Founder Summit 2026 roundtables: Go deeper on the challenges founders are solving right now
items.summary: TechCrunch Founder Summit 2026 is coming to SoWa Power Station in Boston on November 4, bringing founders, investors, and operators together for a full day of candid conversations, practical sessions, live pitching, networking, and smaller roundtables built for deeper discussion.
items.creator: TechCrunch Events
